mainEntity.name: What materials are typically used for stair repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The materials used for stair repair depend heavily on the existing staircase and the nature of the damage. For wooden stairs, common materials include hardwood planks (oak, maple, pine), treated lumber for structural elements, wood fillers, and various types of adhesives and fasteners. For concrete stairs, repairs may involve specific concrete patching compounds, rebar replacement, and resurfacing materials. Frasheski Construction sources high-quality, durable materials appropriate for the specific repair, ensuring longevity and a seamless finish that matches your existing structure as closely as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stair repair materials vary by existing type and damage; wood stairs use hardwoods and lumber, concrete stairs use patching compounds. We source durable, matching materials for longevity.
